The Government of Grenada has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Unleashing the Blue Economy of the Caribbean Project (UBEC) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for the consulting services for theDevelopment of the National Tourism Policy for Grenada, Carriacou, and Petite Martinique.

 

The Government of Grenada, through the Unleashing the Blue Economy of the Caribbean (UBEC) Project, is advancing the World Bank’s twin goals and the OECS Regional Partnership Strategy by promoting a sustainable and resilient Blue Economy. This approach supports the responsible and integrated use of marine and coastal resources to boost economic growth, strengthen livelihoods and protect the health of ocean ecosystems. Within this framework, sustainable tourism is a key pillar, guiding the development of an environmentally responsible, culturally rich and economically viable tourism sector that aligns with interconnected areas such as fisheries, the environment with emphasis on conservation practices especially as it relates to coastal tourism development and waste and risk management.

 

You can find the detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment at the following websites: www.procurement.gd or https://in-tendhost.co.uk/GND/aspx/Home. Alternatively, you can email beverley.jeremiah@procurement.gov.gd  for assistance with the TOR or help with registering on In-tend.

 

The Ministry of Mobilisation, Implementation, and Transformation hereby invites eligible consultants to express their interest in providing the required services. Interested consultants are requested to submit information that demonstrates their qualifications and relevant experience to effectively carry out the services.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers September 2023, revised November 2020, August 2018 and November 2017(“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The best-qualified consultant to carry out the services will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant Selection (INDV) method set out in the Regulations and based on the following criteria:

The Consultant must have the following qualifications and experience:

Required Qualifications:

  • A Master’s degree in Tourism Policy, Planning and Development, Public Policy,
  • Economics, or its equivalent from an accredited university. 
  • 8-10 years of work experience in tourism policy planning and development.
  • At least 5 years’ experience in conducting stakeholder engagement with public and private
  • sector including both high-level consultations with senior public officials and community
  • engagement. 
  • At least 5 years’ experience in formulating technical reports, studies, drafting policy and
  • policy-related documents. 
  • Knowledge and understanding of the institutional context of Grenada’s Tourism Ministry
  • and agencies, incorporating cultural considerations into the policy framework. 
  • Demonstrated experience in successfully leading and completing at least two (2) similar
  • projects involving the development or revision of policies in Caribbean Tourism. 
  • Excellent written, verbal communication and presentation skills in English.

Further information can be obtained by requesting clarification via Intend https://in-tendhost.co.uk/GND/aspx/Home .

Expressions of interest must be submitted electronically through the procurement system at https://in-tendhost.co.uk/GND/aspx/Home . Candidates must register on this portal and submit all interest and queries through this medium. Upon submission of documents, you will receive a confirmation email acknowledging receipt.

procnotices.notice_text:
TERMS OF REFERENCE

Environmental and Social (E&S) Specialist

Individual Consultant

GFPP Preparation Grant No. TF0C8875

1. Background

The Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan, through the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF), is implementing preparatory activities under the Grant Facility for Project Preparation (GFPP Preparation Grant No. TF0C8875).

The Grant is processed under the World Bank’s Investment Project Financing (IPF) and is subject to the Environmental and Social Framework (ESF). An Environmental and Social Commitment Plan (ESCP) has been agreed with the World Bank and forms part of the Project’s legal obligations.

In parallel, a Program Action Plan (PAP) has been developed in preparation for a potential follow-on Program-for-Results (PforR) operation. The PAP includes actions related to strengthening environmental and social systems, institutional capacity, grievance redress mechanisms, and operational procedures.

The Program Operational Manual (POM), prepared under the Grant, must reflect ESCP commitments and incorporate relevant environmental and social actions identified in the PAP.

The Ministry seeks to recruit an individual Environmental and Social Specialist to support implementation of ESCP commitments and ensure proper integration of environmental and social procedures into the POM.

2. Objective of the Assignment

The objective of the assignment is to:

  • Support implementation of Environmental and Social commitments under the ESCP;
  • Ensure compliance with the World Bank Environmental and Social Standards (ESS1, ESS2, ESS10);
  • Support integration of relevant environmental and social actions from the PAP into operational documentation, the Consultant shall also ensure alignment with the World Bank's PforR Core Principles (particularly Core Principles 4, 5, and 6 on social management, vulnerable groups, and grievance mechanisms);
  • Lead preparation of the Environmental and Social chapter of the Program Operational Manual (POM).

3. Scope of Services

3.1 Capacity Building of Participating Financial Institutions (PFIs)

The Consultant shall:

  • Develop training materials and presentations on social risk management and ESF requirements;
  • Deliver training sessions for Environmental and Social (E&S) specialists and designated social coordinators of PFIs;
  • Provide practical guidance on implementation of social screening, inclusion measures, and grievance handling procedures.

3.2 Development and Implementation of Social Inclusion Guidelines

The Consultant shall:

  • Building on the findings of the Environmental and Social Systems Assessment (ESSA), review and validate identified gaps in existing ESMS at participating banks, with particular attention to equitable access for vulnerable groups including women, persons with disabilities, rural students, and low-income families;
  • Identify gaps against applicable ESS requirements;
  • Develop Social Inclusion and Equal Access Guidelines for the Program;
  • Support PFIs in integrating these guidelines into their internal procedures;
  • Support the establishment or strengthening of social risk management procedures and related documentation.

3.3 Strengthening of the Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM)

The Consultant shall:

  • Assess existing complaint handling systems within PFIs;
  • Develop a Program-specific GRM framework;
  • Establish dedicated contact channels (hotline, email address);
  • Prepare and disseminate information materials (brochures, posters) explaining the GRM process.

3.4 Establishment of a Unified, Publicly Disclosed GRM

The Consultant shall:

  • Develop and operationalize a unified and publicly disclosed GRM applicable to all PFIs under the Program;
  • Conduct awareness-raising activities among stakeholders regarding grievance procedures;
  • Train bank coordinators and staff on effective grievance management;
  • Monitor and track outreach indicators (number of sessions conducted, stakeholders reached, feedback received).

3.5 Development of a Code of Conduct

The Consultant shall:

  • Develop a comprehensive Code of Conduct applicable to all Program staff and agents;
  • Ensure alignment with ESS2 and ESS4 requirements;
  • Include provisions addressing non-discrimination, gender-based violence (GBV), sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA), and sexual harassment (SH);
  • Coordinate development with the HR Department of the Ministry of Economy.

3.6 Confidential Mechanism for Sensitive Complaints (SEA/SH)

The Consultant shall:

  • Formally establish a confidential grievance mechanism for sensitive complaints, including SEA/SH-related cases;
  • Develop secure reporting channels (dedicated phone number and/or QR-code-based digital submission);
  • Coordinate with IT departments of participating banks to enable anonymous digital complaint submission;
  • Ensure secure data handling, restricted access, and survivor-centered referral protocols.

3.7 Independent Review of Borrower Selection Process

The Consultant shall:

  • Conduct a selective review of loan documentation from each participating bank;
  • Assess compliance with principles of fairness, transparency, and non-discrimination;
  • Prepare an independent analytical report with findings and recommendations.

3.8 Stakeholder Consultations

The Consultant shall:

  • Organize and document formal consultations conducted through the Bank’s Environmental and Social (E&S) Coordinators:
    • Student groups,
    • Women’s associations,
    • Organizations representing persons with disabilities;
  • Prepare consultation minutes and a stakeholder feedback matrix;
  • Ensure that stakeholder feedback is reflected in Program implementation.

3.9 Development and Implementation of Stakeholder Engagement Plan (SEP)

The Consultant shall:

  • Develop a comprehensive Stakeholder Engagement Plan (SEP);
  • Establish quarterly beneficiary surveys conducted through participating organizations;
  • Ensure systematic documentation and analysis of stakeholder engagement activities.

3.10 Integration of Feedback into Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E)

The Consultant shall:

  • Integrate stakeholder feedback mechanisms into the Program’s M&E framework;
  • Coordinate with the M&E Specialist to introduce measurable indicators, including:
    • Number of consultations conducted;
    • Availability and use of grievance channels;
    • Analysis of complaints received;
    • Corrective actions undertaken;
  • Ensure inclusion of these indicators in regular Program reports.

3.11 Strengthening Data Protection and Cybersecurity Protocols

The Consultant shall:

  • Assess existing data protection policies and confidentiality procedures within PFIs;
  • Verify the existence of data protection provisions in student loan management systems;
  • Liaise with bank IT and security departments to review internal data protection regulations;
  • Provide recommendations to mitigate social risks related to personal data misuse, discrimination, or confidentiality breaches.

The Consultant’s role is advisory and compliance-oriented, focusing on social risk implications rather than technical IT system development.

3.12 Development of the Environmental and Social Chapter of the POM

The E&S Specialist shall serve as the technical focal point for environmental and social matters in preparation of the POM and shall work closely with the POM Consultant.

The Specialist shall:

  1. Draft the Environmental and Social chapter of the POM;
  2. Ensure that the POM fully reflects ESCP commitments;
  3. Integrate relevant E&S provisions derived from the PAP into the POM;
  4. Define institutional roles and responsibilities for E&S management;
  5. Establish E&S screening and risk management procedures applicable to Grant activities;
  6. Integrate Labor Management Procedures (LMP) into the POM;
  7. Integrate GRM procedures into the POM;
  8. Define monitoring, reporting, and documentation arrangements;
  9. Review draft versions of the POM and provide written technical clearance of E&S sections prior to submission to the World Bank.

The Specialist shall ensure that the POM translates ESCP obligations and relevant PAP actions into practical and implementable procedures.

Each deliverable shall be subject to review and approval by the Client (MEF), in consultation with the World Bank as required. A deliverable shall be considered accepted if it:

GOVERNMENT OF PAKISTAN

BENAZIR INCOME SUPPORT PROGRAMME (BISP)

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANCY SERVICES)

The Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP), Government of Pakistan, has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Crisis Resilient Social Protection (CRISP) Program”. BISP intends to apply a portion of the proceeds of this financing to engage the services of Individual Consultants under the CRISP Program, which is funded by the World Bank;

Sr. No.

Position

Required Qualification & Experience

01.

Operations Design & Planning Specialist (ODPS)

(01 Position)

Qualification:  First class/Grade A/3.0/4.0 GPA with minimum 16 years of education in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Data Science, Management Sciences or a related discipline from a reputed academic institution. A PhD shall be an asset.

 

Experience:  Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 years should be in the design, management, and/or evaluation of large-scale social protection, social registry, or MIS systems. Experience with dynamic/on-demand registries is strongly preferred. Demonstrated proficiency in statistical software (Stata, R, or Python); experience with large-scale survey data management; familiarity with API-based data integration and administrative data linkage. Working knowledge of GIS or spatial data tools would be an asset. Demonstrated experience in design and analysis (especially inclusion/exclusion error analysis) of objective beneficiary targeting systems, and development of M&E frameworks for large-scale programs. Strong comprehension, analytical reasoning and report writing skills are essential to complete the job requirements.

 

02.

Hybrid Social Protection Specialist (Monitoring & Evaluation)

(01 Position)

Qualification: First class/Grade A/GPA 3.0/4.0 master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Public Policy, Social Sciences, or a related field from a reputed academic institution. A Ph.D. degree shall be preferred.

 

Experience: A minimum of 7+ years of experience in designing and conducting process evaluations or operational research studies, preferably in social protection programs. Expertise in statistics, data sciences and data management will be essential. Proficiency in software for conducting data analysis (SPSS, Strata, Python and R etc.) will be essential. Strong comprehension, analytical reasoning and report writing skills are essential to complete the job requirements. Experience of working with large-scale Government projects and International Development Partners will be an asset. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Strong organizational skills. Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.

03.

Awareness Strategy Specialist

(01 Position)

Qualification: First class/Grade A/GPA 3.0/4.0 master’s degree in Mass Communication, Marketing, Public Relations, Social Sciences, Development Economics or a related field from a reputed academic institution. A Ph.D. degree shall be preferred.

 

Experience: A minimum of 7+ years of experience in public awareness, communications, or related fields, preferably in the public sector or with large non-governmental organizations. Proven track record of developing and implementing successful awareness campaigns at national and/or provincial levels. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Proficiency in digital marketing and social media platforms. Strong project management and organizational skills. Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders. Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.

 

  • Detailed Terms of Reference (TORs) for the post can be downloaded from www.bisp.gov.pk.
  • The Consultant shall be selected in accordance with the method contained in Section VII, paragraphs,7.36 and 7.37 of the “World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers”, July 2016 [Revised November 2017 and August 2018] (“WB Procurement Regulations”), which can be perused at the website: https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/products-and-services/brief/procurement-new-framework
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. T.A/D.A will not be admissible.
  • Remuneration would be negotiable commensurating to qualification and experience of the candidate.
  • The attention of interested eligible Individual Consultants is drawn to Section III. Paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers July 2016, [Revised November 2017 and August 2018] (“WB Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.
  • Applications must be submitted online through BISP’s official website (www.bisp.gov.pk) within fifteen (15) days of publication of this advertisement.
  • Applicants are required to complete the prescribed “Online Application Form” and upload a detailed, updated CV.
  • Applications received via postal/courier service, email, or by hand will not be entertained.
  • The last date to apply for the post is  23rd April, 2026.

Director HR (Policy & Regulations)

La République du Tchad a reçu un Don de l’Association Internationale pour le Développement (IDA) pour financer les activités du Projet pour l’Autonomisation des Femmes et le Dividende Démographique en Afrique Sub-Saharienne Plus (SWEDD+), et à l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce Don pour effectuer des paiements au titre du Marché relatif à l’acquisition des motos pour les répondants, les points focaux et les partenaires pour le suivi des ONG dans les zones d’intervention du projet   sous-projets 1, 2,3 et 4.

Le ministère des Finances, du Budget, de l’Economie et du Plan à travers le Projet pour l’Autonomisation des Femmes et le Dividende Démographique en Afrique Sub-Saharienne Plus (SWEDD+) sollicite des offres de la part de soumissionnaires éligibles et répondant aux qualifications requises pour fournir les équipements objet de cet appel d’offre.

La procédure sera conduite par mise en concurrence nationale en recourant à un Appel d’Offres National (AON) telle que définie dans le « Règlement applicable aux Emprunteurs – Passation des Marchés dans le cadre de Financement de Projets d’Investissement  Directives : « Fournitures, Travaux, Services Autres que des services de Consultants et Services de Consultants de Juillet 2016, révisé en septembre         2017, août 2018 et Novembre 2020» de la Banque Mondiale (« le Règlement de passation des marchés »), et ouverte à tous les soumissionnaires de pays éligibles tels que définis dans les Règles de passation des marchés.

Les Soumissionnaires intéressés et éligibles peuvent obtenir des informations auprès de : Unité de Gestion du Projet SWEDD+, sise au quartier Repos, Rue de 30m, dans le 4ème arrondissement à côté du Lycée de la Liberté. Tel : (+235) 22 53 10 56 Courriel : sweddtchad@gmail.com ; BP : 2268 N’Djaména – Tchad et prendre connaissance des documents d’Appel d’offres à l’adresse e-mail mentionnée ci-dessus de 7 heures à 15 heures 30 minutes tous les jours et les vendredis de 7 heures à 12 heures 30 minutes, heure locale.

Le Dossier d’Appel d’offres en Français peut être acheté par tout Soumissionnaire intéressé en formulant une demande écrite à l’adresse ci-dessous contre un paiement non remboursable de 50 000 FCFA. La méthode de paiement sera en espèces contre reçu. Pour les fournisseurs étrangers qui désirent avoir le dossier via DHL ou autres, le frais de transfert est à la charge du fournisseur. Le dossier d’appel d’offres sera adressé sous pli fermé.

Les offres devront être remises à l’adresse ci-dessous au plus tard le 07 /05/2026 à 10 heures précises, heures locales. La soumission des offres par voie électronique ne sera pas autorisée. procnotices.notice_text:
Invitation to Bid for

Electronic Title Document Management System (E-DMS)

(Design, Supply and Installation)

(Without Prequalification)

 

Purchaser: Department of Agrarian Reform

Project: Support to Parcellation of Lands for Individual Titling (SPLIT)

Contract title: Supply and Installation of an Electronic Title Document Management System (E-DMS) to manage DAR-related data

Country: Philippines

Loan No.: IBRD / 91410 

RFB No: SPLIT-REF-043-A

Issued on: April 7, 2026

1.        The Government of the Philippines (GOP)has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Support to Parcellation of Lands for Individual Titling (SPLIT) Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Supply and Installation of an Electronic Title Document Management System (E-DMS) to manage DAR-related data.

2.        The Department of Agrarian Reform now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for the development of a user-friendly and comprehensive electronic Title Document Management System (E-DMS) to manage DAR-related data.

           The E-DMS will be developed with two distinct but related thematic components: the Core System and the Administrative System. The Core System, which is under the scope of this procurement, will streamline the processes involved in or related to parcelization by automating manual tasks, whereby a central database will track the status of Collective Certificates of Land Ownership Award (CCLOAs) and generate reports crucial to the management. This will enable monitoring of field office performance efficiently resulting in optimization and allow convenient data retrieval through a systematic archiving system. The system will be equipped with functionalities that allow flexibility to generate evolving data requirements such as those on sex, age, productivity, and vulnerability, together with interoperability with other systems of partner agencies to promote seamless data interoperation.

3.        Bidding will be conducted through national competitive bidding using Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” dated July 2016, revised November 2017 and August 2018 (“Procurement Regulations”), and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations that meet the following minimum qualification criteria:  

  1. The bidder shall furnish documentary evidence that it meets the following financial requirements: 
  • The minimum average annual turnover of the Bidder should be not less than 150% of the offered bid price, calculated as total certified payments received for contracts in progress or completed, within the last three (3) years (2022, 2023, 2024).  Where the Bidder is a Joint Venture the sum of all Partners' average turnover amounts may be used.  Also, where the Bidder is a Joint Venture, the Partner in charge must have had an average annual turnover equivalent to at least seventy-five percent (75%) of the amount required, whereas the other partner(s) shall have not less than twenty-five percent (25%) of the total requirement.   

The Bidder shall provide audited balance sheets or if not required by the law of the Bidder’s country, other financial statements acceptable to the Purchaser, for the last three (3) years (2022, 2023, 2024) to demonstrate the current soundness of the Bidders financial position and its prospective long-term profitability.     

  • The Bidder must demonstrate access to, or availability of, financial resources such as liquid assets, unencumbered real assets, lines of credit, and other financial means, other than any contractual advance payments to meet the following cash-flow requirement: PHP 14,168,000.00 or equivalent in the contract currency net of the Bidders’ other commitments.  
  1. Experience and technical capacity: 

The bidder shall furnish documentary evidence (including detailed description of the functional and technical features of the referenced systems, details of the relevant project references, Letters of Certification/Acceptance Certificates (from clients or certified auditors) and contact information (i.e. telephone and e-mail addresses) of client(s) to support the claims of previous experience) to demonstrate that it meets the following experience requirements: 

  • Experience under Information System contracts in the role of prime supplier, management contractor, JV member, or subcontractor for at least the last ten (10) years (2015 – 2025) years prior to the applications submission deadline. 
  • Participation as a prime supplier, management contractor, JV1 member in: 
    • At least two (2) successfully implemented contracts of similar nature and complexity within the last ten (10) years, demonstrating capacity for development, supply and implementation of Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS) using the proposed technology stack, or comparable technologies, for government agencies or large enterprise clients.

The successfully completed similar contracts shall be documented by a copy of an Operational acceptance certificate (or equivalent documentation satisfactory to the Purchaser) issued by the purchaser(s).

  • The following experience, while not mandatory, will be considered an advantage:
    • Successful development and implementation of an information system related to Land Administration within the last ten (10) years;
    • Demonstrated experience in Web-based Geographic Information System (Web GIS) development involving integration of geospatial data for public sector projects;
    • Experience in the development and implementation of mobile applications for field data collection or workflow management related to land or asset management activities.

The Bidder shall provide supporting documentation or testimonials from at least 1 reference site demonstrating such experience.

  • The Bidder shall demonstrate the implementation of recognized quality management and information security standards in software development and system implementation. The Bidder shall submit valid certification(s), below must be provided as proof:
    • ISO 9001 for quality management systems;
    • ISO 27001 for information security management systems (ISMS).

 

  • The Bidder shall demonstrate experience in the development and implementation of solutions using the software platform or technologies offered in its Bid, or technologies of similar architecture, scale, and complexity.

 

  1. Staff qualification 

Project Team Leader: 

The Project Team Leader shall be responsible for the overall management and technical oversight of the project, ensuring timely and quality delivery of all outputs in accordance with the project objectives and contractual requirements. The Team Leader shall coordinate closely with the Client and relevant stakeholders, manage the project team, and ensure effective integration of technical activities with the operational requirements of the land administration domain.

Education Qualifications:

  • A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or similar project management certification is highly desirable.

Experience:

  • At least ten (10) years of demonstrated experience in project management, including the successfully delivery of at least one (1) project of similar scale and complexity involving information systems development or implementation.
  • At least five (5) years of hands-on experience in the project's technical domains, including software development, IT infrastructure, and systems interoperation.
  • Demonstrated experience in the use of project management tools e.g., Jira, MS Project, and other related tools for project management platforms.
  • Previous experience in Land Administration Systems, Cadastre, Land Records Management, or similar government land-related information systems will be considered a distinct advantage.

 

Business Area Expert/Business Analyst:

The Business Expert (BAE) shall provide domain expertise in Land Administration and Cadastre, ensuring that the system design, functional requirements, and implementation are aligned with the operational processes, legal framework, and institutional requirements of land administration agencies.

Education Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in administration, Information Systems, or any related field.

Certifications:

  • Relevant certifications in the business area, Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Six Sigma, or other industry-specific credentials are an advantage.

Experience:

At least five (5) years of demonstrated professional experience in Land Administration Systems, Land Titling Systems, or Cadastral Information Systems, working as a business analyst, subject matter expert, consultant, or team lead.

  • Previous experience in working with government land administration agencies such as Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR), Land Registration Authority (LRA), Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), or similar institutions is an advantage.
  • Proven experience in land administration systems or cadastre is mandatory.
  • Experience in at least two (2) relevant system development, digital transformation, or implementation projects related to land administration, land records management or cadastral systems.

 

Quality Assurance (QA) Expert:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or any related field.

Certifications (Preferred but not Mandatory):

  • ISTQB Certified Tester (Foundation or Advanced Level), Certified Quality Analyst (CQA), or equivalent QA certifications.

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of cumulative experience in software quality assurance, preferably with experience in large-scale government or enterprise information systems.
  • Involvement in at least one (1) large-scale system implementation project with end-to-end QA responsibilities.

In cases where Bidder does not have direct institutional experience in land administration systems, Bidder may engage or employ a qualified Land Administration Expert or Business Area Expert as part of the proposed project team. The expert must demonstrate relevant professional experience in land administration, land titling systems, or cadastral information systems, preferably with government agencies such as DAR, LRA, DENR, or similar institutions, to ensure adequate domain expertise for the project.

 

4.        Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from the Department of Agrarian Reform,  by writing to the e-mail: procurementdivision.darco2013@gmail.com; dar.bacsecretariat.b@dar.gov.ph during office hours 08:00 to 17:00 at the address given below.

5.        The bidding document in English may be obtained by interested eligible Bidders upon the submission of a written application to the e-mails:

 procurementdivision.darco2013@gmail.com; dar.bacsecretariat.b@dar.gov.ph. The document will be sent by e-mail.[1]

6.        Bids must be delivered to the address below on or before May 7, 2026 at 10:00 AM local time (GMT +8). Electronic Bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. Bids will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend at the address below on May 7, 2026 at 10:00 AM local time (GMT +8).

7.        All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid-Securing Declaration.

8.        Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document.

9.        The address referred to above is:

Atty. Maybelle T. Fajila, Chairperson

BAC Secretariat, Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR)

Procurement Division,

G/F DAR Main Bldg. DAR Compound

Avis d’Appel d’offres National

PAYS : Mauritanie

 

NOM DU PROJET : Projet Régional d’appui au Pastoralisme au Sahel (PRAPS II)

Intitulé du Marché : Travaux de construction de 40 stations hydrauliques pastorales complètes en quatre lots distincts dans plusieurs Wilayas

 LOT1 : Réalisation de travaux de 9 stations pastorales solaires dans la wilaya du Hodh Charghui;

LOT 2 : Réalisation de travaux de 8 Stations pastorales solaires dans la wilaya de l’Assaba et du Hodh El Gharbi ;

LOT 3 : Réalisation de travaux de 11 Stations pastorales solaires dans la wilaya du Tagant, du Gorgol, du Guidimagha et l’Adrar;

Lot 4 : Réalisation de travaux de 12 Stations pastorales solaires dans la wilaya du Trarza, et Brakna

 

Don : Don IDA D 796-MR

Référence : DAON n° 001/CPMP - ME /PRAPS II MR /2026

 

1. Le Gouvernement de la République Islamique de Mauritanie a reçu un financement de la Banque Mondiale pour financer la seconde phase du Projet Régional d’appui au Pastoralisme au Sahel (PRAPSII-MR), et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce don pour effectuer des paiements au titre du marché « Réalisation de travaux de 37 stations pastorales complètes en quatre lots distincts dans plusieurs Wilayas ». Pour ce marché, l’Emprunteur procédera aux paiements en utilisant la méthode de décaissement telle que définie dans les Directives de Décaissement de la Banque Mondiale pour le financement des projets d’investissements.

2.   Le PRAPS II, agissant pour le compte du Ministère de l’Elevage comme Maitre d’Ouvrage sollicite des offres de la part de soumissionnaires éligibles et répondant aux qualifications requises pour exécuter les travaux de construction de 40 stations pastorales hydrauliques complètes en quatre (04) lots distincts dans plusieurs Wilayas.

 

3.   Les délais d’exécution des travaux sont :

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

The Republic of Tajikistan

TAJIKISTAN MILLATI SOLIM PROJECT

Grant No.: IDA / TF C2344

 

Assignment Title: Develop a concept for the delivery of mobile primary healthcare services to the hard-to-reach population in Tajikistan  

Reference No. MOHSP/TMSP/CQS/026/001

The Republic of Tajikistan has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Tajikistan Millati Solim Project (P178831), and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The objective of this assignment is to develop an evidence-based concept of providing mobile PHC services to people living in remote and hard-to-reach areas of Tajikistan[1], taking into account the existing healthcare system and the approved PHC service package.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the link given below: https://docs.google.com/document/d/17AIurh26PaB3r0sMqzjDQ7vxU4PKSDYQ/edit?usp=drive_link&ouid=106869564107009802860&rtpof=true&sd=true

Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  • Core business of the firm and 3 years in business;
  • Relevant experience in performing at least 2 similar assignments of comparable nature, complexity, and scope, preferably in mobile healthcare, primary healthcare, or services for hard-to-reach populations;

Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

INVITACIÓN A PRESENTAR EXPRESIONES DE INTERÉS

PREPARACIÓN DEL PROYECTO DE ACCESO A LA ENERGÍA EN HONDURAS

DONACIÓN No. E570-HN

 

CONSULTORÍA

“Asistencia para la obtención de información legal, técnica y de geolocalización y diseño de planos para el desarrollo de proyectos de electrificación en extensión a la Red de Distribución de la ENEE, localizados en los departamentos de Olancho y Colón”

 

PROCESO No. HN-UCP-ENEE-523381-CS-INDV.

El Gobierno de Honduras ha solicitado financiamiento e inversión al Banco Mundial con el objetivo de fortalecer y ampliar los esfuerzos de electrificación en zonas de difícil acceso en Honduras. El proyecto propuesto tiene como finalidad aumentar el acceso a la electricidad en territorios con alta concentración de población indígena y afrodescendiente, contribuyendo así al desarrollo económico local y al mejoramiento del bienestar social. La iniciativa se focaliza en los departamentos de Gracias a Dios, Olancho y Colón.

Los servicios de la consultoría ("los Servicios") incluyen la contratación de los servicios de cuatros (4) profesionales calificados para que realicen los trabajos necesarios para la obtención de información técnica, de geolocalización y los permisos de paso y servidumbre, en trabajos de campo, y la formulación de los perfiles (diseños eléctricos) para el desarrollo de proyectos de electrificación en extensión a la red eléctrica existente situados en varias comunidades de los departamentos de Olancho y Colón.

Los términos de referencia (TDR) se podrán obtener de manera gratuita accediendo a la página web de la Institución www.enee.hn y al sitio www.honducompras.gob.hn o solicitarlos mediante el correo electrónico abajo descrito.

La Empresa Nacional de Energía Eléctrica ENEE, por este medio invita a los consultores elegibles a expresar su interés en prestar los servicios solicitados; los consultores interesados deben proporcionar información que demuestre que tienen las calificaciones requeridas y la experiencia relevante para prestar los Servicios.

El/La Profesional deberá cumplir con las siguientes calificaciones mínimas:

Formación Académica: Profesional Universitario con título académico a nivel de ingeniería eléctrica, mecánica y/o electromecánica o carrera afín[1]. De ser seleccionado el profesional deberá acreditar su preparación con copia simple del título universitario.

Experiencia General: Experiencia de al menos cuatro (4) años laborados[2], contados a partir de la fecha de obtención de su título de grado académico universitario; en el desempeño de actividades como responsible de la supervisión de obras o administración de contratos, relacionados con proyectos de construcción de infraestructura eléctrica o en el desempeño de actividades propias de la ingeniería eléctrica en general. El Consultor debe acreditar los trabajos y tiempo trabajado.

Experiencia específica:

  • De al menos cuatro (4) proyectos ejecutados en los últimos cuatro (4) años, en donde se haya desempeñado en posiciones de supervisor del proyecto, constructor o responsible de administrar el contrato, en la construcción de redes de distribución de media y baja tensión de energía eléctrica para ser incorporados a las redes de la ENEE, con potencias instaladas superiores o iguales a 50KVA y al menos de 30 postes hincados[3].
  • De al menos 5 diseños de proyectos de electrificación en formato AutoCad-2D e ingresados y aceptados o proyectos recibidos (solo se contabilizará el ingreso de diseño o su recepción, no ambas) por la ENEE en los últimos cuatro (4) años, con al menos una potencia de 50 KVA y al menos 30 postes hincados (aplica mismo pie de página 8); se debe acreditar con evidencia documental.

Otros Estudios/Especializaciones/Conocimientos: Se valorará el manejo de aplicaciones informáticas de diseño de redes de distribución y cálculo para ingeniería eléctrica, aparte de AutoCAD.

El/La Consultor(a) será seleccionado(a) conforme a los procedimientos indicados en las: Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios en Proyectos de Inversión - Adquisiciones en Operaciones de Financiamiento para Proyectos de Inversión, Bienes, Obras, Servicios de No-Consultoría y Servicios de Consultoría, Sexta Edición, Febrero de 2025; Métodos de Selección Aprobados para Consultores Individuales, específicamente "Selección Abierta y Competitiva de Consultores Individuales". Se llama la atención de los Consultores interesados sobre la Sección III, párrafos 3.14, 3.16, y 3.17 de las "Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios para PFI" del Banco Mundial revisadas en Febrero de 2025, que establece la política del Banco Mundial sobre conflictos de intereses.

Los interesados en participar deberán enviar y cumplir con lo siguiente:

  1. Carta de expresión de interés debidamente firmada que indique el número y nombre del proceso y del interesado.
  2. Hoja de vida actualizada, que describa las calificaciones y experiencia con las que cuenta el interesado(a) para realizar el trabajo mencionado, incluyendo copia de Título Universitario, diplomas, documentación soporte que valide la experiencia general, especifica, otros estudios y conocimientos solicitados; copia DNI o Pasaporte.

Los y las postulantes que no cumplan con estos requisitos su hoja de vida no será evaluada.

Se puede obtener más información en el horario de oficina de 08:00 a.m. a 04:00 p.m. de lunes a jueves y de 08:00 a.m. a 03:00 p.m. los viernes.

RÉPUBLIQUE D'HAÏTI

MINISTÈRE DES TRAVAUX PUBLICS, TRANSPORTS ET COMMUNICATIONS

UNITÉ CENTRALE D’EXÉCUTION (UCE)

 

Projet de connectivité résiliente et d’accessibilité du transport urbain

(RUTAP)

(P177210)

DP-009-RUTAP/2026

 

Appel à Manifestation d’Intérêt

Étude portant sur la reconfiguration et l’aménagement des trois (3) carrefours suivants : Carrefour Rond-Point / Pont Neuf - Carrefour Samarie - Carrefour Rue 5 / Rue A

  1. Le Gouvernement de la République d’Haïti a reçu un financement de la Banque mondiale pour financer le Projet de Connectivité Résiliente et d’Accessibilité du Transport Urbain (RUTAP). Une partie de ce financement servira à payer les dépenses prévues au titre d’un contrat de Services de Consultant en vue de la Sélection d’un Consultant pour Une Étude portant sur la reconfiguration et l’aménagement des trois (3) carrefours suivants : Carrefour Rond-Point / Pont Neuf - Carrefour Samarie - Carrefour Rue 5 / Rue A (DP-009-RUTAP/2026). 
  1. Sans être limitatif, le Consultant aura à réaliser deux études spécifiques qui sont :
  1. Une étude des usages existants et futurs dans la périphérie de ces carrefours qui consiste à :
  • Évaluer les déplacements de véhicules et de piétons générés par une gare routière régionale ou une station de lignes de banlieue ;
  • Évaluer les déplacements de véhicules et de piétons générés par un marché public formel ou informel ; et
  • Spécifiquement pour le carrefour Rond-Point / Pont Neuf, tenir compte d’un terrain de 62,000 mètres carrés environ se trouvant à l’est/sud-ouest du carrefour et pour lequel actuellement il n’y a pas d’utilisation projetée, connue.
  1. Une étude technique proprement dite de chacun de ces carrefours comprenant :
    • Les études topographiques ;
    • Les études géologiques et géotechniques (essais et sondages) ;
    • Les études de déplacement ;
    • Le Diagnostic de fonctionnement ;
    • Une Inspection de sécurité routière ;
    • La détermination du type de carrefour à aménager, ses caractéristiques géométriques et celles des tronçons de route qui s’y rattachent et le dimensionnement des couches de chaussée ;
    • Les études de drainage du carrefour et de ses abords ;
    • L’évaluation de l’impact environnemental ;
    • L’évaluation quantitative et financière de l’ouvrage à construire ainsi que tous les travaux connexes.

            ou

Les Consultants intéressés doivent fournir des informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et l’expérience pertinente pour exécuter les Services. Les critères de sélection sont les suivants :
  • Avoir au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans l’étude de voirie urbaine et avoir des compétences avérées dans l’étude de carrefours dans des zones urbaines denses de pays en voie de développement ;
  • Avoir travaillé sur des études socio-économiques en zone urbaine de pays en voie de développement ;
  • Disposer d'une expertise régionale ou mondiale en matière de sécurité routière en zone urbaine ;
  • Être reconnu à l’échelle d’Haïti ou mondiale et justifiant des références dans l’études de carrefours en zone urbaine dense de pays en voie de développement ; en particulier avoir trois (3) références de consultations antérieures pour des études similaires à ce mandat ;

1. T.C. Sanayi Teknoloji Bakanlığı Sanayi Genel Müdürlüğü, Türkiye Yeşil Sanayi Projesi maliyetinin karşılanması amacıyla Dünya Bankası’ndan finansman almıştır ve bu finansmanın bir kısmını danışmanlık hizmetlerinin temini için kullanmayı planlamaktadır.

2. Türkiye Yeşil Sanayi Projesi; sanayide yeşil dönüşümü hızlandırmayı, karbonsuzlaştırma çabalarını yoğunlaştırmayı ve çevresel sürdürülebilirliği artırmayı hedefleyen politika ve stratejilerin geliştirilmesini amaçlamaktadır. Projenin, Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı Sanayi Genel Müdürlüğü tarafından yürütülen 4. Bileşeni kapsamında Türkiye Döküm Sektörü için Düşük Karbonlu Yol Haritasının Hazırlanması İşi Kapsamında Danışmanlık Hizmeti alınacaktır. Alınması planlanan hizmetin kapsamına www.tgip.sanayi.gov.tr bağlantısından ulaşılabilir. İşin Haziran 2026’da başlaması ve 8 (sekiz) ay sürmesi beklenmektedir.

 

3. Danışman Firmanın (Danışman) seçimi, Dünya Bankası “IPF Borçluları için Satın Alma Düzenlemeleri” doğrultusunda “Danışmanların Niteliklerine Dayalı Seçim (CQS) Yöntemi” usul ve esaslarına uygun olarak yapılacaktır. İlgilenen Danışmanlık Firmalarının, Dünya Bankası’nın çıkar çatışmasına ilişkin politikasının açıklandığı Kasım 2020 tarihli “IPF Borçluları için Satın Alma Düzenlemeleri” Bölüm III, paragraf 3.14, 3.16 ve 3.17’ye dikkat etmeleri gerekmektedir. İlgi Bildirimlerinin 20.04.2026 Pazartesi günü saat 14:00’e kadar tgip@sanayi.gov.tr adresine e-posta eki olarak gönderilmesi gerekmektedir. İlgilenen danışmanlar ayrıca İlgi Bildirimlerini şahsen, taahhütlü posta yoluyla veya kurye aracılığıyla da iletebilirler.

4. T.C. Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı Sanayi Genel Müdürlüğü, uygun niteliklere sahip danışmanlık firmalarını bu hizmetleri sunmak üzere İlgi Bildiriminde bulunmaya davet etmektedir.

İlgilenen danışmanlar, aşağıdaki konularda yeterli deneyim ve kapasiteye sahip olduklarını gösteren bilgi ve belgeleri sunmalıdır.

5. Danışman seçme kriterleri şunlardır.

 

  1. Danışman, son başvuru tarihinden itibaren son 5 (beş) yıl içinde büyüklük, benzerlik ve karmaşıklık açısından istenen hizmetlere benzer danışmanlık hizmetlerinde en az 1 (bir) adet iş deneyimine sahip olmalıdır (belge ile kanıtlanmalıdır).
  2. Danışman, bu İş Tanımında açıklanan hizmetlerin yerine getirilmesi için gerekli eğitim ve tecrübede kadroya sahip olduğunu göstermelidir.
  3. Danışmanın Uluslararası Kuruluşlar (BM, DB, AB, JICA vb.) tarafından finanse edilen proje tecrübesine sahip olması tercih sebebidir.

6. Bir danışmanlık firması, görevi tek başına yerine getirecek yeterliliğe sahip olduğunu düşünüyorsa ilgi beyanını tek başına sunabilir; danışmanların yabancı veya yerel başka bir firma ile ortaklık kurması zorunlu değildir.

 

Bununla birlikte danışmanlar, göreve ilişkin niteliklerini ve kapasitesini artırmak amacıyla ortaklık kurmayı tercih edebilirler. Bu ortaklık aşağıdaki şekillerde olabilir:

  • Ortak Girişim (Joint Venture): Ortak girişimin tüm üyeleri işin yerine getirilmesinden müteselsilen sorumlu olacaktır.
  • Alt danışman (Sub-consultant): Ana danışman, alt danışmanın sunduğu hizmetler dâhil olmak üzere işin tamamından sorumlu olacaktır.

Bir ortaklık söz konusu olduğunda, danışmanlar İlgi Beyanı (EOI) başvurusunda aşağıdaki hususları açıklamak zorundadır:

a) Ortaklığın kurulma gerekçesi

b) Ortak girişimde yer alan her bir üyenin ve/veya alt danışmanın görev kapsamındaki beklenen rolü ve ilgili nitelikleri

 

Bu açıklamaların İlgi Beyanı içerisinde yer almaması durumunda, ilgili ortaklık kısa listeye alınmama riski ile karşı karşıya kalabilir.

 

Ayrıca önemle belirtilmelidir ki, danışman seçimi amacıyla yapılan EOI değerlendirmesinde yalnızca ortak girişim üyelerinin nitelikleri dikkate alınacak olup, önerilen alt danışmanların nitelikleri değerlendirmeye alınmayacaktır.

 

7. İlgilenen danışmanların aşağıdaki belgeleri sunmaları beklenmektedir:

 

  • Ticaret sicil kayıt belgeleri
  • Firma tanıtım dokümanı veya şirket profili
  • Benzer sözleşmelere ilişkin deneyim bilgileri (Ek-1 formatında)
  • Tamamlanmış sözleşmelere ait referans mektupları veya iş bitirme belgeleri teklif aşamasında talep edilebilir.

 

Değerlendirme sürecini kolaylaştırmak amacıyla, İlgi Bildirimlerinde sunulacak benzer iş deneyimleri Ek-1’de yer alan formatta sunulacaktır. Danışmanlar, deneyimlerini göstermek amacıyla ilgili projelere ilişkin referans bilgilerini bu formatta sağlayacaktır. Sunulabilecek toplam referans sayısı en fazla 20 (yirmi) adettir. Bu sayının üzerinde sunulan referanslarda, 21 inci ve sonraki sıradaki referanslar değerlendirmeye alınmayacaktır. Referans listesi ayrıca Türkçe olarak elektronik ortamda sunulacaktır.

 

8. İlgi Bildirimlerinin 20.04.2026 Pazartesi günü saat 14:00’e kadar tgip@sanayi.gov.tr adresine e-posta eki olarak gönderilmesi gerekmektedir. İlgilenen danışmanlar İlgi Bildirimlerini şahsen, taahhütlü posta yoluyla veya kurye aracılığıyla da iletebilirler.

procnotices.notice_text:
REPÚBLICA DE ANGOLA

MINISTÉRIO DA ADMINISTRAÇÃO DO TERRITÓRIO

PROJECTO DE FORTALECIMENTO DA GOVERNAÇÃO PARA MELHORIA DA PRESTAÇÃO DE SERVIÇOS EM ANGOLA – NJILA

Unidade de Implementação do Projecto (UIP)

Solicitação de Manifestação de Interesse

País: Angola.

Nome do Projecto: Projecto Njila.

  Projecto ID N. º P178040.

Descrição do Contrato: Contratação de um(a) Especialista Ambiental para a URIP4

No. do Contrato: AO-MAT-534969-CS-INDV

O Governo de Angola assinou um acordo de empréstimo com o Banco Mundial, para a implementação do Projecto de Fortalecimento da Governança para a Melhoria da Prestação dos Serviços em Angola, cujos objectivos são: (i) Aumentar o montante e a fiabilidade das transferências fiscais para municípios seleccionados; (ii) reforçar a sua capacidade financeira e de gestão fundiária; (iii) aumentar a cobertura de identidade.

O Projecto é multissectorial, envolvendo os seguintes Departamentos Ministeriais: Ministério das Finanças, Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos, Obras Públicas, Urbanismo e Habitação, Administração Pública, Trabalho, Segurança Social e o Ministério da Administração do Território, que tem a responsabilidade de coordenar, através de uma Unidade de Implementação do Projecto (UIP).

O Projecto terá a duração de quatro (4) anos e para assegurar a sua  implementação torna-se necessário preencher o quadro de pessoal da Unidade Regional de Implementação do Projecto (URIP), com técnicos capazes de dar suporte a execução, incluindo um(a) Especialista Ambiental, para garantir o cumprimento e conformidade ambiental ao nível das Unidades Regionais de Implementação do Projecto, apoiando a coordenação na implementação do das actividades relacionadas com as questões ambientais durante toda a fase de implementação. Esta contratação terá como principal função apoiar a Coordenação na garantia do cumprimento dos requisitos legais nacionais e os requisitos ambientais do BM, de acordo com o Quadro Ambiental e Social (QAS).

O objectivo geral desta consultoria (os serviços) é de assumir a responsabilidade pela implementação dos instrumentos preparados no âmbito do projecto, a nível regional, nomeadamente Quadro de Gestão Ambiental e Social (QGAS), Plano de Compromissos Ambientais e Sociais (PCAS), Procedimentos de Gestão de Mão-de-Obra (PGMO), entre outros.

A duração desta contratação é de 12 meses, renováveis em função do desempenho satisfatório. Os Termos de Referência podem ser obtidos no endereço abaixo indicado.

O Projecto de Fortalecimento da Governança para a Melhoria da Prestação de Serviços em Angola, convida os candidatos “interessados” (Consultores Especialistas Ambientais) elegíveis a manifestarem o seu interesse em prestar os serviços. Os candidatos interessados deverão fornecer informações que demonstrem qualificações requeridas e experiência relevante para executar os serviços.

O(A) Candidato(a) deve possuir as seguintes qualificações: (I) Licenciatura em Gestão Ambientais, Engenharia Ambiental, Ciências Naturais, Biologia ou em áreas afins; (II) Mínimo 2 (dois) anos de experiência relevante para esta posição; (III) Experiência na aplicação das Políticas de Salvaguardas do Banco Mundial, com o Quadro Ambiental e Social do Banco Mundial e ainda com os Padrões de Desempenho do IFC; bem como com a legislação ambiental nacional angolana aplicável; (IV) Conhecimento dos regulamentos/directivas e operações pertinentes das organizações multilaterais de desenvolvimento e das agências de execução. Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em organizações internacionais; (V) Experiência na elaboração e monitoria de EAS/PGAS; (VI) Formação e experiência em Saúde e Segurança Ocupacional (SSO); (VII) Capacidade comprovada em trabalhar com várias partes interessadas, incluindo entidades governamentais, organizações da sociedade civil (OSCs), comunidades locais e sector privado; (VIII) Comprovada capacidade técnica, analítica, escrita e comunicação, bem como algum conhecimento do trabalho do Banco Mundial; (IX) Domínio das ferramentas informáticas, especificamente o MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); (X) Domínio da Língua Portuguesa e inglesa.

Os candidatos deverão ter atenção ao Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial para Mutuários de Financiamentos de Projectos de Investimento de Setembro de 2025, à Secção III, parágrafos 3.14, 3.16, e 3.17 das referidas Normas, que definem a política do Banco Mundial sobre o conflito de interesse. O referido documento pode ser consultado na seguinte hiperligação:https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/products-and-services/brief/procurement-new-framework.

Os interessados deverão obter informação adicional no endereço abaixo indicado das 8H00 às 15H00. As manifestações de interesse (Currículo, cópia dos certificados de habilitações académicas e outras informações pertinentes) deverão ser entregues até o dia 17 de Abril de 2026, apenas os Consultores qualificados na etapa de avaliação curricular serão contactados para as entrevistas.

REPUBLIQUE ISLAMIQUE DE MAURITANIE

 

MINISTERE DE LA TRANSFORMATION NUMERIQUE ET DE LA MODERNISATION DE L’ADMINISTRATION (MTNMA)

Projet Régional d'Intégration Numérique en Afrique de l'Ouest (WARDIP)

AVIS DE MANIFESTATION D’INTERET

AMI 40/C/MTNMA/WARDIP/2026

 

Etude sur la connectivité internationale par câble sous- marin de la Mauritanie et ses besoins futures en termes de capacité et de redondance

 

 

Le Gouvernement de la République Islamique de Mauritanie, avec l’appui de la Banque Mondiale, a l'intention d’intégrer le Projet Régional d'Intégration Numérique en Afrique de l'Ouest (WARDIP) pour promouvoir la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de transformation numérique du Pays qui vise à développer la pénétration de l'Internet haut débit, des services financiers numériques et des services en ligne (e-Gouvernement).

Le Projet Régional d'Intégration Numérique en Afrique de l'Ouest (WARDIP) – Composante Mauritanie, (ci-après le « Projet ») à travers des actions impliquant les pays de la sous-région, vise spécifiquement à (a) créer un environnement propice au bon développement d’infrastructures numériques adéquates, (b) développer les réseaux à large bande et les services d’internet et (c) simplifier l’accès aux services en ligne.

Dans le cadre de la composante 2 « Développement et intégration du marché de la connectivité », le Projet cherche à recruter un Consultant (firme) qui assistera le Gouvernement Mauritanien pour réaliser une « Etude sur la connectivité internationale par câble sous- marin de la Mauritanie et ses besoins futures en termes de capacité et de redondance ».

Le Projet WARDIP-MR invite les consultants (firme), admissibles et ayant une expérience avérée dans la réalisation de missions analogues à manifester leur intérêt pour fournir lesdits services.

La méthode de passation choisie est la Sélection basée sur la Qualification des Consultants (SQC) conformément au Règlement de Passation des Marchés, pour les Emprunteurs Sollicitant le Financement des Projets d’Investissement (FPI)- Juillet 2016 Révisions Novembre 2017, Août 2018 et Novembre 2020.

Le Gouvernement de la République du Congo a reçu un financement de la Banque mondiale pour financer le Projet d’Amélioration des Services d’Electricité (PASEL), et à l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce financement pour effectuer des paiements au titre du Marché de fourniture, d’installation et mise en exploitation de 26 000 compteurs intelligents et des équipements associés pour la création d'une plateforme de gestion des grands clients. Pour ce marché, l’Emprunteur utilisera la méthode de décaissement par Paiement Direct, telle que définie dans les Directives de Décaissement de la Banque mondiale pour le Financement de Projet d’Investissement, à l’exception des paiements pour lesquels le marché prévoit l’utilisation de crédit documentaire. »

Le Projet d’Amélioration des Services d’Electricité (PASEL), sollicite des offres fermées de la part de soumissionnaires éligibles et répondant aux qualifications requises pour fournir, installer et mettre en exploitation 26 000 compteurs intelligents, dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre du programme de protection des recettes (PPR) visant à surveiller systématiquement à travers une infrastructure de comptage avancée (AMI) la consommation des 26 000 plus gros clients (tous approvisionnés en HT, MT et BT avec une consommation mensuelle supérieure à 1 000 kWh). NATIONAL COMPETITIVE BIDDING

FEDERAL DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF ETHIOPIA

MINISTRY OF URBAN AND INFRASTRUCTURE

SPECIFIC PROCUREMENT NOTICE

 

 

(CONSULTANCY SERVICES – INDIVIDUAL SELECTION)

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

FOR INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANCY SERVICES

 

Country: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia

Project Name: Ethiopia Rural Connectivity for Food Security Program (RCFSP)

Financing: International Development Association (IDA)

Assignment Title: Digital Media Specialist

Reference No.: ET-MUI-535754-CS-INDV

 

The Government of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia has received a grant from the International Development Association (IDA) toward the cost of the Ethiopia Rural Connectivity for Food Security Program (RCFSP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds of this grant to payments for consulting services for a Digital Media Specialist.

 

The Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure (MUI), through the RCFSP Program Coordination Office, intends to recruit a qualified Individual Consultant (Digital Media Specialist) to support the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) in strengthening digital communication, information disclosure, and public engagement activities of the program.

 

The Digital Media Specialist will support the PIU and the Ministry in implementing digital communication and visibility activities that ensure timely, accurate, and accessible dissemination of project information, achievements, and development results to stakeholders, including beneficiaries, government institutions, development partners, media, and the general public.

 

The consultant will be responsible for preparing and implementing a digital communication and visibility strategy, managing project digital platforms, developing communication materials, supporting citizen engagement initiatives, and ensuring compliance with World Bank communication, visibility, and disclosure requirements.

 

The duration of the assignment will be twelve (12) months, renewable subject to satisfactory performance and project needs.

The Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure now invites eligible Individual Consultants to indicate their interest in providing the services. Interested consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services.

The shortlisting criteria include the following:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Digital Media, Marketing, Development Studies, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree in a relevant field will be considered an added advantage.

Adequacy for the assignment:

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in digital communications, preferably within World Bank–financed or other multilateral development bank (MDB) projects.
  • Demonstrated experience in World Bank visibility, public disclosure, or stakeholder engagement activities is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with government institutions or Project Implementation Units (PIUs) will be considered an asset.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in content management systems and social media management tools.
  • Strong skills in graphic design and multimedia production (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, video editing software).
  • Good understanding of SEO, digital analytics, and performance reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Amharic and English.

Core Competencies

  • Results-Based Communication: Ability to communicate outputs, outcomes, and impacts aligned with the project’s Results Framework.
  • World Bank Compliance Awareness: Knowledge of World Bank policies on visibility, disclosure, citizen engagement, and ESF-related communication.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with government counterparts, consultants, communities, and World Bank staff.
  • Professional Integrity and Accountability: Ability to deliver high-quality outputs within agreed timelines in a PIU environment.

The selection of the Individual Consultant will be carried out in accordance with the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: Procurement in Investment Project Financing – Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services (Fifth Edition, September 2023).

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours from 8:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. and 1:30 p.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday to Friday. Dead line for the application submission will be on April 20, 2026.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

 

RECRUITMENT OF A CONSULTANCY FIRM TO CONDUCT INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION OF RESULTS FOR THE REGIONAL OFF-GRID ELECTRICITY ACCESS PROJECT (ROGEAP)

 

Date: 12th March 2026

Duty Station: Lomé, Togo; selected ECOWAS countries; Home Based

Name of Project: Regional Off-Grid Electricity Access Project (ROGEAP)

Assignment Title: Recruitment of a Consultancy Firm to Conduct Independent Verification of Results for ROGEAP

Reference No.: NG-ECOWAS-OCEM-539853-CS-CQS

 

The Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) Commission has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of implementing the Regional Off-Grid Electricity Access Project (ROGEAP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

 

The consulting services (“the Services”) include:

  • Mapping the ROGEAP’s Results Framework, data flows, and reporting systems across all project components and participating countries.
  • Verifying key Project Development Objective (PDO) and intermediate indicators, including electricity access for households, MSMEs, and public institutions, credit volumes under Component 2, and standards/quality assurance milestones.
  • Conducting statistically sound sampling, desk review, phone surveys, site visits, GIS/remote sensing verification, and financial attribution checks.
  • Performing data quality assessments (DQA) and gender, inclusion, and environmental & social (E&S) compliance verification.
  • Reconciling reported vs verified results, providing adjustments, and preparing a clean auditable dataset for Management decision-making.
  • Preparing deliverables including Inception Report, monthly fieldwork notes, Draft Verification Report, Final Verification Report, clean dataset, and presentation(s) to the Bank and Steering Committee.

 

The overall purpose is to provide independent verification of ROGEAP results to validate achievements, assess reporting reliability, and support decisions regarding the project extension.

 

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found on the following websites:

https://www.ecowas.int/procurement/procurement_m/intellectual-services/ /

https://ecowas.rogeap.org/a-propos-de-nous/passation-des-marches/

 

The ECOWAS Commission now invites eligible consultancy firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The shortlisting criteria are:

 

  1. Firm Experience
  • At least 10 years of experience in monitoring and evaluation, results verification, or impact assessment of large multi-country development programs.
  • Demonstrated experience in independent verification of results for projects financed by international financial institutions (World Bank, AfDB, etc.).
  • Proven experience in energy access, renewable energy, infrastructure programs, or financial intermediary operations.
  • Experience conducting field verification, statistical sampling, surveys, and data quality assessments.

 

 

  1. Team Qualifications
  • Team Lead: Master’s degree in relevant field; 10 + years in results verification or M&E of large, multi-country energy access or infrastructure programs; experience with World Bank/IFIs; conducted at least in 2 similar assignments; fluent in English and French.
  • M&E/Quant Methods Specialist: Master’s degree in relevant field; 5 years of experience in M&E; sampling/statistics; survey design; DQA frameworks; participated in at least one similar assignment, fluent in English and French.
  • Energy Access/Technical QA Expert: Master in Renewable Energy, 5 years of experience in stand-alone solar systems, quality standards, testing labs; fluent in English and French.
  • Finance Specialist: Master’s degree in finance, 5 years of experience on lending, credit lines, and financial intermediary operations (BOAD/CFIs); fluent in English and French.
  • Field Supervisors / Enumerators: Bachelor’s degree in statistics, social sciences, economics, energy, or a related field. At least 3 years of experience in field data collection, surveys, and verification activities for development projects. Fluency in at least one ECOWAS working language (English, French, or Portuguese) is required.
  • GIS / Remote Sensing and Data Engineer: Master’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), remote sensing, geomatics, data science, or a related field. At least 5 years of experience in geospatial analysis, remote verification techniques, and management of geo-referenced databases within development projects. Experience with data platform integration and data security protocols is required.
  • Gender and Environmental & Social (E&S) Specialist: Master’s degree in gender studies, international development, social sciences, environmental studies, or a related field. At least 5 years of experience in gender-responsive monitoring and evaluation and environmental and social compliance in development projects. Familiarity with environmental and social standards applicable to internationally funded projects is required.

Note: Citizens of ECOWAS Member States are particularly encouraged to apply.

 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” fourth edition November 2020.

 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

 

A consultant will be selected in accordance with the Consultant Qualifications Selection (CQS) method, as set out in the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (November 2020).

 

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours Monday to Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (GMT +1) Local Time.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in written form to the addresses below by e-mail by 1st April 2026 at 11:00 AM (GMT +1) Local Time.

MANGROVES FOR COASTAL RESILIENCE ( P178009 )

IBRD-93740

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (REOI)

NAMA PAKET:

LAYANAN PAKET SELEKSI NGO UNTUK PENYEDIA KEGIATAN DESA MANDIRI PEDULI MANGROVE (DMPM) SUMATERA UTARA  (LOT-1) ; RIAU (LOT-2) ; KALIMANTAN TIMUR (LOT-3) ; KALIMANTAN UTARA (LOT-4)

Program M4CR juga dirancang untuk mengakomodir implementasi kebijakan pengelolaan ekosistem mangrove berkelanjutan, konservasi secara menyeluruh, serta penguatan platform koordinasi multisektor, baik di tingkat nasional maupun daerah, termasuk pelibatan pemangku kepentingan dari Lembaga Swadaya Masyarakat (LSM) dan sektor swasta guna mewujudkan tata kelola ekosistem mangrove yang terpadu, efektif, dan berkeadilan. Melalui pendekatan kolaboratif ini, pelestarian mangrove diharapkan tidak hanya mendukung perlindungan lingkungan, tetapi juga meningkatkan kesejahteraan ekonomi dan sosial masyarakat pesisir yang bergantung pada sumber daya tersebut.

Proyek M4CR bekerja di tingkat akar rumput menggunakan pendekatan pembangunan desa partisipatif yang berupaya mendorong pengelolaan mangrove yang berkelanjutan dan pemberdayaan ekonomi masyarakat di sekitar mangrove melalui pengembangan Desa Pengelolaan Mangrove (Desa Mandiri Peduli Mangrove - DMPM). DMPM mengintegrasikan berbagai bentuk rehabilitasi mangrove ke dalam agenda pembangunan desa/ kelurahan dan mendorong pelaksanaan kegiatan rehabilitasi mangrove yang berkelanjutan di tingkat tapak. Ada tujuh (7) pilar yang menjadi bagian tidak terpisahkan dari DMPM, yakni: 1. Pemulihan ekosistem berbasis masyarakat desa 2. Opsi-opsi sumber penghidupan masyarakat 3. Kelembagaan yang efektif 4. Integrasi Perlindungan dan Pengelolaan Ekosistem Mangrove 5. Kemitraan dan Kerjasama 6. Partisipasi Aktif Masyarakat 7. Edukasi Menuju Perubahan Perilaku.

Kegiatan Desa Mandiri Peduli Mangrove (DMPM) dimaksudkan untuk mendorong pengelolaan ekosistem mangrove yang partisipatif, berkelanjutan, dan berbasis komunitas lokal. Agar pelaksanaan kegiatan tepat sasaran, DMPM membutuhkan data profil desa yang tidak hanya berupa peta (spasial), melainkan juga non spasial (profil masyarakat desa dari segi sosial, ekonomi dan potensi-potensi lainnya). Sebagai bagian dari Program Mangroves for Coastal Resilience (M4CR), kegiatan ini menekankan integrasi pengelolaan mangrove dalam dokumen perencanaan desa, penguatan regulasi lokal, serta mekanisme pemantauan dan evaluasi guna menjamin keberlanjutan pengelolaan ekosistem. Pendekatan ini bertujuan agar upaya konservasi dan pemanfaatan mangrove sejalan dengan perlindungan sosial dan lingkungan melalui penerapan prinsip kehati-hatian dan partisipasi aktif masyarakat.

Pengadaan ini terakumulasi sebagai Lot 1: Jasa Konsultan Kegiatan Desa Mandiri Peduli Mangrove (DMPM) Provinsi Sumatera Utara ; Lot 2: Jasa Konsultan Kegiatan Desa Mandiri Peduli Mangrove (DMPM) Provinsi Riau; Lot 3: Jasa Konsultan Kegiatan Desa Mandiri Peduli Mangrove (DMPM) Provinsi Kalimantan Timur; Lot 4: Jasa Konsultan Kegiatan Desa Mandiri Peduli Mangrove (DMPM) Provinsi Kalimantan Utara.  

Jasa Layanan NGO meliputi: (1) Bimbingan Teknis (bimtek) Tenaga Fasilitator Desa (Kelembagaan); (2) Pengembangan Data Dasar DMPM; (3) Penguatan Kelembagaan melalui Integrasi Pengelolaan Mangrove ke dalam Peraturan di Tingkat Desa; (4) Integrasi rencana pengelolaan mangrove berkelanjutan ke dalam Rencana Pembangunan Desa; (5) Pendampingan dan Asistensi DMPM; (6) Melaksanakan pemantauan, pelaporan dan evaluasi serta pembelajaran.

Durasi penugasan selama 7 bulan.

Sumatera Utara: https://bit.ly/DMPM_SUMUT
Riau : https://bit.ly/DMPM_RIAU; 
Kalimantan Timur : https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/187L-1A3BcnnjgkzPcOMzcDRCSgs-Tj8f?usp=drive_link 
Kalimantan Utara : https://bit.ly/DMPM_KALTARA

yang diumumkan pada web https://spse.inaproc.id/kehutanan

M4CR akan mengadakan seleksi NGO melalui Kelompok Kerja Pemilihan (POKMIL), yang memenuhi syarat untuk menyatakan minat dalam menyediakan Layanan. NGO yang berminat harus memberikan informasi yang menunjukkan bahwa memiliki kualifikasi dan pengalaman yang relevan untuk melaksanakan Layanan tersebut. NGO yang berminat harus memberikan deskripsi yang memadai tentang penugasan sejenis (termasuk lokasi/negara, nama Pemberi Kerja/Klien, jenis layanan yang diberikan, jangka waktu kontrak, jumlah kontrak, tanggal mulai dan selesai).

  Kriteria Seleksi sebagai berikut:

  1. Organisasi nirlaba non pemerintah yang terdaftar di Indonesia pada lembaga yang berwenang,
  2. Memiliki dokumen legal (NPWP, Akta pendirian dan perubahannya, KTP Pengurus, bukti lapor pajak tahunan/SPT dua tahun terakhir);
  3. Laporan keuangan dua tahun terakhir yang telah diaudit oleh Kantor Akuntan Publik (KAP);
  4. Mempunyai atau menguasai kantor dengan alamat yang benar tetap dan jelas berupa milik sendiri atau sewa di Indonesia;
  5. Tidak pernah terkena sanksi dari Bank Dunia maupun dari pemerintah Indonesia (format terlampir);
  6. Memiliki jaringan aktif dan/atau kemitraan dengan NGO, komunitas, dan institusi pemerintah di tingkat nasional dan subnasional, khususnya di provinsi kegiatan;
  7. Melampirkan Pakta Integritas (format terlampir);
  8. Memiliki pengalaman bekerjasama dengan lembaga pemerintah dengan pekerjaan sejenis dalam kurun waktu tiga tahun terakhir dalam pendampingan penguatan kelembagaan desa dan komunitas terkait pengelolaan sumber daya alam atau konservasi ekosistem yang berkelanjutan diutamakan di provinsi target kegiatan;
  9. Diutamakan organisasi yang mendorong pengelolaan dan perlindungan mangrove di Indonesia dengan pendekatan kolaboratif dan partisipatif;
  10. Memiliki tenaga ahli yang berpengalaman pekerjaan sejenis diutamakan di provinsi target kegiatan;
  11. Bukti ketersediaan staf kelembagaan penuh waktu selama seluruh durasi kontrak;

    A. Metode dan proses seleksi
